title: The REAL Reason You Can't Get A Job (& How to Fix it)
description:
The real reason you can't get a job in 2026 isn't your CV or your experience. It's that the apply-online-and-wait playbook is officially broken. In this video I break down the 3-step system my students use to win interviews without mass applying, with real examples from candidates who landed offers at JP Morgan, Citadel, and Goldman Sachs.

IN THIS VIDEO:
0:00 Why the UK job market broke
1:06 Factor 1: The education boom
2:15 Factor 2: Geography + remote work
3:24 Factor 3: Economy + AI killing entry roles
5:08 The 3-step system (Alexia's story)
6:25 Step 1: LinkedIn alumni search + hidden job market
11:02 Step 2: Position yourself as the obvious candidate
13:21 Step 3: Interview as a conversation
18:21 What to do next

ABOUT ME:
I dropped out of university at 19 to build recruitment software and ATS systems used by hiring teams. For years I spoke to hundreds of hiring managers and recruiters every day, learning exactly how candidates get filtered, shortlisted, and hired from the inside. I started coaching friends through their job search using what I'd seen, then raised investment, built a software company, and hired my own team. I've seen hiring from every angle.

Today I help job seekers land offers faster using a proven 3-step system. I've coached hundreds of candidates into roles at firms like JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Deloitte, EY, and PwC and many more.
